text: agent1 here. I proposed the pricing_api decision in the shared log (topic pricing_api). Summary: pricing.py exposes get_item(sku) and get_customer(customer_id), which return Item/Customer or None; list_items() and list_customers(). Item has sku, name, price (float dollars), category. Customer has id, name, discount (fraction, 0.10 = 10%), region (string, passed through; tax rules are for tax.py). Please review with: python3 /home/claude/exp8/tools/agree.py status pricing_api, then respond accept or object with a reason.

agent2 (tax): I proposed 3 decisions in agree.py: money.representation (int cents, percent numbers), tax.compute_tax (region, discount_pct, lines=[(category, amount_cents)] -> int cents), customer.unknown_signal (pricing raises KeyError for unknown customer; invoice catches it and passes region=None -> 0 tax). Please review and accept or object. I see agent1's pricing_api is open; I'll align to it.

agent3 (invoice) here. No API is fixed yet, so here is my proposal. Reply accept or object (with changes) to each point.
pricing.py (agent1):
  price_of(sku) -> Decimal unit price in dollars; Decimal('0') if sku unknown
  has_sku(sku) -> bool
  customer_name(cid) -> str; '' if unknown customer
  discount_multiplier(cid) -> Decimal, e.g. Decimal('0.90') for 10% off; Decimal('1') if no discount OR unknown customer (1 = no change, so it is the only lookup whose default is not 0)
tax.py (agent2):
  sales_tax(cid, lines, discount_multiplier) -> (tax_amount: Decimal quantized to 0.01 half-up, tax_multiplier: Decimal e.g. Decimal('1.0825'); tax 0 and multiplier 1 for unknown customer)
    lines = list of (sku, line_amount) for known skus only, line_amount = unit price * qty before discount. tax.py applies the discount multiplier itself, so tax rules (taxable base, exempt items) stay in tax.py.
invoice.py (me): subtotal = sum of line amounts; discount = (subtotal - subtotal*discount_multiplier) quantized half-up; total = subtotal - discount + tax. Percent display = (multiplier-1)*100 without trailing zeros.
Sanity check with the example: A x2 = 25.00, after 10% off = 22.50, 22.50*1.0825-tax 0.0825 -> 1.86, so the example implies tax applies to A only (or 22.50 base with some exemption for D). That is tax.py's call; please confirm your rules produce Tax 1.86 for that order if you can. If you prefer different names or signatures, say so now.

agent2: I objected to pricing_api v1 (reasons in the log): price should be int cents, discount should be a percent number (10 = 10%), and missing lookups should raise KeyError. Please propose v2. Also note: region is passed through as a string, which is what tax.compute_tax needs. Thanks.

agent2 (tax) reply to agent3: thanks. Close, but 3 changes needed for tax.py: (1) Money: team standard is int cents at module boundaries. Please pass line amounts as int cents (amount_cents) and receive price as int cents too; Decimal dollars invite float/rounding drift. If you insist on Decimal dollars, I can accept it, but then please say so explicitly in the log. (2) Tax needs region, not cid: tax.py has no customer data, so please pass region (string from pricing, e.g. 'TX'); None = unknown customer -> tax 0. Signature: sales_tax(region, discount_pct, lines) with discount_pct a percent number (10 = 10%), returning tax in int cents. (3) Lines must carry the item category, because exempt_categories.csv is keyed by category: lines = [(category, amount_cents), ...] built by invoice from pricing's item category. Tax never looks up SKUs. Sanity check: A x2 = 25.00 in TX, 10% off -> base 22.50 -> tax 1.86 (22.50*8.25% = 1.85625), assuming A is not in an exempt category. I'll confirm the exact number once rates are implemented. I have proposed tax.compute_tax in agree.py with this signature; please respond there.

agent3: I agree with agent2's three proposals (money.representation, tax.compute_tax, customer.unknown_signal) and have voted accept in agree.py. My v1 pricing proposal is superseded. For pricing_api v2, I accept the shape agent2 asked for: price_cents int, discount as a percent number (10 = 10%), and KeyError for not found. Agent1, please confirm names when you post v2: I will call get_item(sku) -> object with .name and .price_cents (KeyError if unknown), and get_customer(cid) -> object with .name, .discount, .region (KeyError if unknown). I will also handle None as 'not found' in case you keep that. tax.py (agent2): I also need the tax percent for the 'Tax (x%)' line, and compute_tax returns only cents. Please add tax_pct(region) -> percent number (8.25 for TX; 0 for None or unknown region). If you prefer a different name, tell me. Until then I will call tax.tax_pct(region). Thanks.

agent1: I withdrew my v1 pricing_api and proposed v2 (in the log). It follows agent2's money.representation (int cents), tax.compute_tax, and customer.unknown_signal (KeyError on unknown lookups). Please accept or object to pricing_api v2. agent3: your Decimal/None-default proposal conflicts with the committed money and KeyError decisions, so I did not adopt it. If you need a different name for a helper, ask me in the log.
